subject_definitions: <Subject 1> = character identity — A female warrior with long silver-white hair tied in a high ponytail with a gold crown, wearing a black and crimson traditional Hanfu with intricate gold embroidery and red tassel earrings; her expression is cold and composed (derived from Reference Image 1).
<Subject 2> = character identity — A male warrior with short black hair, piercing yellow eyes, and a scar on his left cheek, wearing a black tactical trench coat with red glowing neon lines and heavy combat boots; his build is muscular and imposing (derived from Reference Image 2).
<Subject 3> = location — A cyberpunk-ancient fusion city square at night, featuring a large circular stone gate in the center, wet stone pavement reflecting purple and blue neon lights, traditional lanterns mixed with futuristic skyscrapers in the background, and heavy rain falling (derived from Reference Image 3).

summary: [reference generation] The target video is a 3-shot sequence generated from <Subject 1>, <Subject 2>, and <Subject 3>, depicting a high-intensity duel in a rain-slicked cyber-ancient square, emphasizing cinematic camera texture and a dynamic rhythm arc from tension to explosive action and final resolution.

retention_analysis: <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - Silver hair, Hanfu outfit, and facial features remain consistent; movement is fluid and precise.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - Tactical coat, yellow eyes, and scar are maintained; posture shifts from aggressive to defeated.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - The rainy cyber-ancient square, neon lighting, and stone gate serve as the constant, atmospheric background.

detailed_description: Cinematic cyber-wuxia aesthetic shot on anamorphic lenses with visible film grain, high-contrast neon lighting, and realistic motion blur; the camera work is dynamic, shifting from tense handheld stability to rapid tracking movements.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000
A medium-wide shot establishes the confrontation within <Subject 3>. The camera is handheld with small amplitude shake at slow speed, creating a sense of unease. <Subject 1> stands on the left, her Hanfu rippling in the wind, facing right. <Subject 2> stands on the right, his tactical coat heavy with rain, facing left. Raindrops hit the lens, creating bokeh effects from the neon signs reading "紫禁之巅". The sound of heavy rain and a low, throbbing bass drone builds tension.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500
The camera cuts to a fast tracking shot following <Subject 1> as she lunges forward. The movement is blurred with high speed. She extends her hand, and a burst of blue energy strikes <Subject 2>. The camera shakes strongly to match the impact. <Subject 2> is thrown backward, his coat flaring. A sharp *crack* of energy and the sound of fabric tearing are heard, cutting through the rain.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500
The shot cuts to a low-angle static shot looking up at <Subject 1>. She stands tall in the center, her hand slowly lowering, water dripping from her fingertips. Behind her, out of focus, <Subject 2> lies on the wet stone, defeated. <Subject 1> turns her gaze slightly toward the camera, her expression calm. <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 承让。</d>. The sound of rain returns to dominance, with a heavy thud from <Subject 2>'s body settling on the ground.

overall_soundscape: Heavy rain pounding against stone and metal; the rustle of wet silk and tactical gear; the sharp crack of energy impact; the heavy thud of a body hitting the ground; the ambient hum of neon lights and distant city traffic.

non_diegetic_music: A tense, low-frequency bass drone builds up during the standoff, culminating in a sharp, dissonant string screech at the moment of impact, then abruptly cutting to silence for the final line, leaving only the diegetic rain.
